design: Add an explicit compound-route sidecar to the compact P05 runtime. CanonicalVerseStore may return a compound route when the aligned source token has a supported compound lexical ID but no ordinary entity ID. BibleIQEngine then renders a source-alignment fallback card without inventing a P03/P04 entity or collapsing the token onto one constituent.
invariants: Do not change the existing 27,206 P01-P04 entities.
Do not create cached EMET explanations for synthetic compound routes.
Do not select one constituent for a genuinely compositional token.
Keep all 78 existing display-to-source-token alignments unchanged.
Only repair the missing source-token-to-word-study route.

plannedSourceChanges.action: Generate public/data/bibleiq/word-study/compound-routes.json from the four locked route definitions and add its checksum/count to the runtime manifest.
Load compound-routes.json and return a compound canonical hit when an aligned Greek source token has no ordinary entity ID but its lexical ID is in the locked route map.
Build a transparent compound source-alignment fallback entity. Show source form, lemma, compound lexical ID, components, verse context, and no cached EMET explanation.
Add optional compound-route metadata used by the canonical hit and public alignment response.
